method: Read the complete relevant official standard-course content lists, their declared binding scope and optional boundaries, and the number-domain entry basis; compare whole unchanged canonical contracts. Absence of a keyword or a missing atomic source mapping is not the evidence rule.
decisionMeaning: The C family is an authored additional topic in these existing standard-course views. It is not part of their closed official obligatory content. The bounded correction removes these whole extra target obligations from the normal-course Personal Curricula. It does not prohibit enrichment, invalidate the mathematics/task content, erase IDs/mastery, or claim that no school ever teaches C.

sourceReview.contentClosure: RLP 2022 p22: the following common GK/LK core and LK additions govern all four semesters; Q4 deepens and connects the prior competencies. Full Q1-Q4 tables pp23-31 were read, not searched for one phrase.
wholeCourseSections: Q1 pp23-25: algebra, real functions, calculus and linear systems
Q2 pp26-28: integral calculus and stochastics
Q4 p31: analysis/stochastics and multi-topic problem solving
sourceReview.entryBoundary: RLP upper pp15-16 specifies N/Z/Q/R and the usual real elementary functions. The current local lower-secondary RLP (2023, validity p2) links level H to upper-secondary entry on p20/36. Complete number-domain tables pp26-27/42-43 end at real numbers and real powers/logarithms.
sourceReview.optionalBoundary: Lower-secondary RLP p66 explicitly separates Wahlpflicht from regular instruction. Its optional history/logical topics do not prescribe the whole complex-history contract. Upper p22 allows deepening and synthesis of the prescribed subjects; this does not turn complex task difficulty into the number field C.
sourceReview.closedExternalAnnex: The referenced 2022 OHiMi appendix was located and all substantive pp5/7-11 read: real algebra, analysis, real vectors and stochastics. Fachbrief 8/2024 printed pp16-17 (physical17-18) explains its disappearance in connection with the IQB formula document. This is a tool/recall boundary, not an addition of a C curriculum. The old annex is retained as historical evidence, not asserted to remain the current exclusive recall list.
sourceReview.authoringTrap: Q4 "komplexe Aufgabenstellungen" means cognitively complex problems across the existing three subjects. It is not a complex-number topic.

countries.positiveKeep: All official real-number/function/geometry/stochastics targets and unrelated assessments; all global complex IDs/content and legitimate HE/BY sources. For BW also preserve the separate VkM as a positive optional-course lead, without adding it to actual normal-course targets.
countries.allOtherCountries: NOT_REVIEWED_IN_THIS_CONTINUATION; carry forward their existing decisions/HOLDs.

courses: GK+LK union; no separate VkM selection

sourceReview.contentClosure: BP2016 printed pp7-8 states that the numbered content standards specify the required content/abilities; pp10-11 distinguish optional deepening and normal Basisfach/Leistungsfach. The full sections 3.4 and 3.5 were read.
wholeCourseSections: Leistungsfach 3.4.1-3.4.5, printed pp39-44 (physical41-46): real-variable algebra/calculus; metric and analytic geometry; real functions; stochastics
Basisfach 3.5.1-3.5.5, printed pp45-49 (physical47-51): the respective complete numbered standards
sourceReview.entryBoundary: Printed pp24-25 (physical26-27) explicitly extend Q to R; pp31-32 (physical33-34) continue real powers, roots, exponentials, real tuples and derivatives. Roots of real polynomials and real vector tuples are not complex-number contracts.
sourceReview.optionalBoundary: RP Stuttgart VkM information (2016) p3 locates the separate Vertiefungskurs in the Wahlbereich; pp4/9 label its detailed topic proposal as a recommendation. It positively includes complex arithmetic/polar form/equations in this separate course. The currently served official teacher-training organisation guidance explicitly discusses choosing VkM alongside the newer LF/BF system; the student sheet pp1-2 also calls it a separate elective course. No existing actual BW Personal Curriculum selects VkM separately, and the Bavarian all-five-module owner decision must not be transferred to BW.
sourceReview.closedExternalAnnex: No omitted subject-content annex is referenced by §§3.4/3.5. The downloaded local PDF embeds two editions; corresponding upper-course pages physical41-51 and101-111 were compared and are text-identical. References here use the first copy. This review binds the declared BP2016 source of the existing G8/G9 views; it does not invent future G9 curriculum obligations.
sourceReview.authoringTrap: A positive VkM source does not make complex numbers a universal Leistungsfach obligation. The RP topic proposal is not itself a fully reviewed source mapping for all 11 atoms or any protected task.

countries.positiveKeep: All official real-number/function/geometry/stochastics targets and unrelated assessments; all global complex IDs/content and legitimate HE/BY sources. For BW also preserve the separate VkM as a positive optional-course lead, without adding it to actual normal-course targets.

sourceReview.contentClosure: KC2019 pp8/11 fixes the content-competence tables and distinguishes general Gymnasium from vocational variants. P36 expressly says the learning areas completely cover the content competencies in §3.2. P36-37 distinguishes their binding Kern from fakultative Erweiterungen. Entire general-Gym E/gA/eA tables and learning areas were read.
wholeCourseSections: E tables pp21-22 and E learning areas pp38-42: descriptive statistics, real elementary functions and differentiation
All five general-Gym guiding ideas, both gA/eA, pp23-28
All gA learning areas pp43-47: curve fitting/linear systems, integrals, e-function, real coordinate geometry, probability
All eA learning areas pp48-54: integrals, growth/e-function, real-space geometry, function families and probability
sourceReview.entryBoundary: Sek-I KC pp23-26 contains the complete number/operation competency table. P33 fixes the core/optional distinction; p34 describes the culminating extension to R. P58 makes Q-to-R and real limiting procedures explicit, with no C extension in that complete learning area.
sourceReview.optionalBoundary: Upper pp36-37 explicitly marks additions beyond Kern as optional. In the eA real-space learning area, further transformation matrices are optional; the core matrices project R3 into R2 for Schrägbilder. That does not prescribe C as an algebra or complex multiplication as 2x2 matrices.
sourceReview.closedExternalAnnex: The general-Gym §3.2.2.1 and §3.3.2.1 content is the relevant course. Vocational variants are not substituted for it. Suggested online instructional materials are implementations, not an undisclosed extra mandatory C module.
sourceReview.authoringTrap: General LGS/matrix vocabulary and an Oberstufe root mapping cannot establish complex arithmetic or C-matrix representation. V16 NI 5503 masks are independent and preserved.

countries.positiveKeep: All official real-number/function/geometry/stochastics targets and unrelated assessments; all global complex IDs/content and legitimate HE/BY sources. For BW also preserve the separate VkM as a positive optional-course lead, without adding it to actual normal-course targets.

sourceReview.contentClosure: KLP2023 p7 identifies the land-wide obligatory core; pp12-16 binds content fields and competence expectations. Entire E, GK and LK content lists in §§2.3/2.4.1/2.4.2 (pp22-30) were read. The general process competencies are combined with those content fields, not an unlimited mathematics-content mandate.
wholeCourseSections: E pp22-23: real polynomial/power-function analysis and real-space vectors/lines
GK pp24-26: all20 analysis,9 geometry/linear-algebra and14 stochastics expectations
LK pp27-30: all23 analysis,12 geometry/linear-algebra and21 stochastics expectations
sourceReview.entryBoundary: Sek-I KLP p7 fixes the common obligatory core; p12 identifies binding content fields. §2.4.2 p32 explicitly ends the number extension at R and provides real quadratic/exponential equation methods.
sourceReview.optionalBoundary: Upper p7/11 permits school-specific additions and deepening; p13 makes clear that competencies do not limit all possible teaching. This allows an honest authored supplementary complex topic, not a universal normal GK/LK target inferred from the word algebra or from generic problem solving.
sourceReview.closedExternalAnnex: No separate C module is part of the complete §§2.3/2.4.1/2.4.2 standard-course content lists. Project/enrichment choices would need their own explicit source/scope decision; the actual audited profiles select normal Mathematics GK/LK.
sourceReview.authoringTrap: The current view heading "Vertiefungen ... komplexe Zahlen" is authored content. Its presence proves current target selection, not official source positivity. Complex-history material can be used as an enrichment example, but the whole named complex-history mastery target is not thereby an obligatory standard-course competency.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Komplexe Zahlen in algebraischer Form additiv nutzen
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract introduces a+bi and real/imaginary parts, then C addition/subtraction. Ordinary real-number or vector addition does not cover it.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Komplexe Zahlen in Polarform und Gaußscher Zahlenebene darstellen
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract requires Gauss-plane and complex polar/exponential representations, magnitude/argument and angular parameter interpretation. Standard real trigonometry/Cartesian vectors is insufficient.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Gleichungen in der Menge der komplexen Zahlen lösen
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract solves equations in C, including non-real quadratic roots. The prescribed real polynomial/quadratic equation work does not entail extending the domain.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Komplexe Zahlen algebraisch dividieren
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract divides in algebraic C form using the complex conjugate. Ordinary fractions, real polynomial division and linear-system solving are not this competency.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Einheitswurzeln komplexer Zahlen am Einheitskreis deuten (LK)
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract enumerates complex nth roots of unity and explains their geometry. The real nth root and the trigonometric unit circle do not imply this complete competency.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Komplexe Zahlen algebraisch multiplizieren
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract multiplies algebraic complex numbers with i²=-1. Polynomial expansion alone omits the introduced number algebra.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Mandelbrot-Folgen komplexer Zahlen softwaregestützt untersuchen (LK)
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole Mandelbrot/software contract is already not selected in these countries. No removal, new target or source obligation is proposed.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Grundrechenarten in der Gaußschen Zahlenebene deuten
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract geometrically interprets all four complex arithmetic operations. Real vector addition/scalar multiplication does not supply complex product and quotient.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Die Zahlbereichserweiterung zu komplexen Zahlen mathematisch begründen (LK)
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract justifies R→C. The expressly prescribed Q→R extension is a different whole competency.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Die kulturhistorische Bedeutung komplexer Zahlen einordnen (LK)
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract explains documented complex-number history. Generic cultural history or optional historical contexts do not make this specific whole history competency obligatory.

wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.title: Komplexe Zahlen als 2×2-Matrizen darstellen (LK)
wholeOrdinaryGoalDecisions.reason: Whole contract represents C as 2x2 matrices. Gauss linear-system notation, real-space projections and geometric transformations do not prescribe this representation of the complex algebra.

wholeProtectedGoalDecisions.wholeContract: 20 BE: nonreal quadratic roots6, Gauss plot4, modulus/argument5, matrix of multiplication by i5. All mandatory subparts remain unchanged. The standard-course conflict is the complete C task, not only its matrix subpart.
wholeProtectedGoalDecisions.noFalseCoverage: The displayed division by the real scalar2 is not algebraic division by a non-real denominator. No 5ba7 requires/coverage edge is added.

wholeProtectedGoalDecisions.wholeContract: 14 BE: non-solvability in R/extension5; material-supported Bombelli step3; geometric acceptance3; evaluate one-inventor assertion3. Generic reasoning/material interpretation permits such an enrichment task but does not prescribe this specific standalone complex-history mastery obligation.

All8 cards: i², a+bi, conjugate, modulus, Euler relation, geometric product, conjugate division rule, roots of unity. Neither the misleading Parameters title nor a subset of familiar words permits a per-card filter. Complete DE/EN decks remain unchanged.
Complete Mandelbrot/software assessment was included in the prior explicit fourth-consumer supplement. It is not selected in any of these42 actual country profiles.
